budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director reported the FY23 budget was 60% expended with 75% of the fiscal year elapsed, heating charges behind, and the program line up as expected.
budget_items.quote: the fy23 budget is 60% expended and we are 75% through the fiscal year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Materials costs, mainly online materials and databases, were expected to come up.
budget_items.quote: a number of materials costs will be coming up, mainly online materials such as kanopy, mango, and online databases.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The contracted services line was open and might be used for painting the community room.
budget_items.quote: muir said it is kind of open right now and may be used for painting the community room.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director presented the FY24 budget to the finance committee; the preliminary budget was stated and most requests were funded.
budget_items.quote: the preliminary budget is $539k. most of the requests were funded.

budget_items.topic: Copy machine lease and camera upgrades
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The copy machine lease and camera upgrades were funded in the town central purchasing and IT budgets rather than the library budget.
budget_items.quote: the copy machine lease and camera upgrades were funded in the town central purchasing and it budgets.

budget_items.topic: Proctor garden construction and maintenance costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Jean was preparing numbers for the garden's construction and maintenance costs; no figures were printed.
budget_items.quote: jean is coming up with some numbers for construction and maintenance.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town and HR, with a consultant, recommended increased pay rates for SAP library staff to reach market rates.
budget_items.quote: the town and hr are working with a consultant and are recommending increased pay rates for the sap library staff in order to come up to market rates.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Heating charges were reported as still a bit behind.
budget_items.quote: heating charges are still a bit behind.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The trustees noted the principal of the trust funds cannot be touched, but interest remains a large share of the funds.
budget_items.quote: we can't touch the principle but the interest is still a large percentage of the funds.
